Game Overview

I Want Ice Cream is a platformer title where guide a lovable penguin through Antarctica's icy landscapes in search of tasty ice cream treats. With charming graphics and a catchy soundtrack, you'll enjoy mastering the game's unique edge-to-edge movement and simple controls. Solve puzzles and outsmart obstacles for a delightful adventure suitable for all ages.
